content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm new to [product_name]. I have a [product_name] device ([article_no]), but I can't locate internal flags or use a normally closed contact. Is it possible for someone to share a link to the manual and explain how to use the keys? Feel free to ask for more details if needed.
Which programming method are you using—Ladder or Function Block Diagram?

The [article_no] model doesn't offer flags. Flags were introduced with [article_no], and even then, only a few were available. Cursor keys can't be programmed on this device; this functionality was added in later versions like [article_no] or higher.
Thanks for the support. Where can I find the technical manual for this product? Do all functions exist with it? I can't seem to find the pulse relay feature.
If you don't have a manual...
How can I achieve latching if there is no internal flag? Ha—probably a silly question. I guess I'll use set/reset logic until I find a better way.
The [product_name] [article_no] is a very old model with limited capabilities and a small number of blocks. Recursive locking is possible only via the digital outputs on this device.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report major functionality constraints when using early hardware generations of [product_name], notably [article_no], including missing internal flags, unprogrammable keys, and fewer function blocks like the absence of pulse relay. Lack of documentation for legacy devices amplifies confusion, especially for inexperienced users. Access to manuals and clear feature comparisons between device revisions would greatly help the community.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect implementations to offer internal flags, expanded functionality (such as pulse relay), and easily accessible manuals or technical documents to support effective learning and practical use.
